statusLine.command: jq -r '[([.model.display_name, .effort.level // empty] | join(" ")), .workspace.current_dir, (.context_window.used_percentage // empty | "ctx \(floor)%"), (.rate_limits.five_hour // empty | "5h \(.used_percentage | floor)% (\(.resets_at | strflocaltime("%H:%M")))"), (.rate_limits.seven_day // empty | "7d \(.used_percentage | floor)% (\(.resets_at | strflocaltime("%a %H:%M")))")] | join(" | ")'
